titles.title: Fairness in Treatment:  The Drug and Alcohol Addiction Recovery Act of 1999

A bill to amend the Public Health Service Act, Employee Retirement Income Security Act of 1974, and the Internal Revenue Code of 1986 to provide for nondiscriminatory coverage for substance abuse treatment service under private group and individual health coverage.
Fairness in Treatment:  The Drug and Alcohol Addiction Recovery Act of 1999
